construction_principle: Each pair keeps approximately the same religious proposition while changing the framing. The positive pole presents the item as sacred teaching, doctrine, scripture, ritual practice, devotional life, or recognized internal tradition. The negative pole presents the same item as myth, legend, folklore, symbolic motif, symbolic drama, or narrative device.

score_interpretation.positive: more non-mythologized / sacred-teaching / doctrinal / ritual-practice framing
score_interpretation.negative: more mythologized / symbolic / legendary / folkloric framing
